maria: Quick design check compact sampling controls for the latency heatmap header on small screens. Figma: https://redwood.internal/figma/compact-sampling-v4. Preview attached. Any concerns about discoverability or accessibility? jake: Nice save on vertical space. My worry is people not noticing it. Maybe show a subtle pulse on first use or a tooltip on hover for desktop? :bulb: anya: A11y checklist: the control must be keyboard focusable, expose aria-expanded, and the tray should be announced when opened. Also avoid color-only indicators for sampling density; include text or pattern. kevin: Copy thoughts: use 'Sampled 10%' or 'Sample: 10%'. 'Sampled' reads like current state; 'Sample:' is more instruction-like. Shortest wins for pills. emi: Product requirement: record telemetry for sampling interactions. Events: ui.sampling.open, ui.sampling.change (old_pct, new_pct, method). Also log open_from dimension (header/timepicker). sam: Technical note: heatmap draws on canvas; we cannot inject interactive DOM there. We'll render the pill as an overlay DOM element anchored to the heatmap container and open a tray component outside the canvas. Keeps rendering simple. designbot: mock uploaded: compact-sampling-header-v1.png https://redwood.design/compact-sampling-header-v1.png :frame_with_picture: maria: Proposed pattern: header pill 'Sample: 10%'. Click -> tray with presets (1/5/10) and 'More' to open slider. Tray supports keyboard, swipe-to-close on mobile, and has focus trap + Escape close. lisa: QA notes: ensure focus returns to the pill, Escape closes, screenreader reads 'Sampling tray opened. Presets: 1 percent, 5 percent, 10 percent'. Test NVDA and VoiceOver. anya: Also add aria-live polite region when percentage changes so SR users hear new value and that sampling affects streaming density. Example snippet: ```html
``` jake: UX shortcut: show presets directly in the pill menu (quick tap) and hide slider under 'More'. Keeps common tasks 1-tap. kevin: Also surface an estimated coverage badge in the tray so users understand tradeoffs: e.g., 'Estimated coverage: ~12k requests / min shown'. Emi to provide estimate API. emi: We'll add a /sampling/estimate endpoint that returns estimated_tokens and expected_latency delta. We'll ship a stub first. Add API contract task to backend backlog. sam: Performance: toggling sampling may require recomputing backfill. Keep client-side optimistic update and show a small toast if estimates are still pending. maria: Consensus: use a header pill 'Sample: 10%' for compact, accessible tray with presets+slider, telemetry hooks, and estimate API. Action: I'll update Figma and file RDW-UI-1410 with mocks and accessibility acceptance criteria. anya: +1. Please include keyboard unit tests and screenreader assertions in the ticket. jake: +1 from design. We'll run a quick usability test for discoverability after prototype. maria: Thanks everyone :sparkles:
